translationResources.title: Funnel chart
translationResources.description: Stages of a process that lose volume along the way (sign-ups, sales pipeline, checkout), with the conversion rate from each stage to the next. Hover or use the arrow keys to highlight a stage; click a legend item to hide it.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: Trapezoids narrow to the next stage and show the conversion rate; renderTooltip adds the share of visitors and the drop-off in React.

bars.title: Bars and sorting
bars.description: shape="bar" draws centered bars for values that are not a sequence; sort orders them (animated) and conversion={false} hides the rates.

ecommerce.title: E-commerce checkout
ecommerce.description: A shop's checkout funnel next to a Table of the drop-off between stages; the stage that loses the most visitors is highlighted in red in both.

recruiting.title: Hiring pipeline
recruiting.description: Candidates of one role from application to hire as bars with one color per stage; the tooltip adds the typical time spent in the stage and a click selects it.

compare.title: Comparing segments
compare.description: The same funnel split by device, side by side with the same stages and one color per segment, to see where mobile users drop out.

campaigns.title: Marketing funnel by channel
campaigns.description: A Select filters the funnel to one acquisition channel and the stages animate to the new counts. renderTooltip adds the conversion from the previous stage and the cost per result, computed from the channel's spend; the line below gives the customer acquisition cost.

what-if.title: What-if conversion model
what-if.description: The −1 / +1 buttons change the conversion rate of one checkout step and the funnel is recomputed from the visits; the summary compares the orders and the revenue with today's rates. Rates are kept in whole percent points so that Reset knows when nothing has changed.

live-sale.title: Live flash sale
live-sale.description: A one-hour sale replayed in 30 ticks (setInterval, cleared on pause, at the end and on unmount): new visitors arrive and move down the stages with a seeded random generator. The status line follows the clock, and only the end of the sale is announced.

sales-pipeline.title: B2B sales pipeline
sales-pipeline.description: Stages sized by the amount of their open deals, with conversion={false} because each stage holds different deals. onClick lists the deals of a stage next to the funnel, and renderTooltip shows their count and win probability.

FunnelChartProps.data: Stages: a name, a value and an optional color
FunnelChartProps.sort: Order of the stages: descending, ascending or the data order
FunnelChartProps.gap: Vertical gap between the stages, in pixels
FunnelChartProps.conversion: Shows the conversion rate from the previous stage
FunnelChartProps.shape: Shape of the stages: trapezoids that narrow to the next stage, or centered bars

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: Each stage narrows to the next one and shows the conversion from the previous stage; tap a stage to select it.

data.signupAria: Sign-up funnel of a mobile app
data.tapStage: Tap a stage to select it

conversion.title: Conversion funnel
conversion.description: Stages narrowing to the next one, each labelled with its conversion rate from the previous stage.

bars.title: Sorted bars
bars.description: Centered bars instead of trapezoids, with the stages sorted by value.

props.hideConversion: Hides the conversion rates from the previous stage
props.height: Height of the chart, the legend included: pixels or any CSS length
props.options: Other engine options (axes, legend, tooltip, palette, format…) merged with the element's own properties; property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) mark changed; detail: { index, name, value, share }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-click: A mark was clicked, tapped or activated with Enter; detail: { index, name, value, share }
events.minerva-toggle: A legend item was clicked (or toggle() called); detail: { index, hidden, hiddenIndexes }

methods.toggle: Hides / shows a slice, stage, radar series or top-level treemap node by index
methods.getRenderer: Backend drawing the shapes (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready; set it with the renderer engine option
